retrievalProfile.description: A painterly, soft-focus male portrait set against a textured, neutral background with ultra-compressed, heavy sans-serif typography in the upper corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man with long dark hair, rendered with a soft, painterly texture that mimics an oil-on-canvas or airbrushed effect. The subject is positioned slightly off-center, looking toward the viewer. The background is a gradient of muted greys and blues with a visible diagonal grain. A black border frames the entire composition, and heavy, vertically-stretched sans-serif text is stacked in the top-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against cool neutral background
Heavy vertical text weight vs. soft organic portrait lines
coreInvariants: Diagonal grain/noise pattern in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait, positioned right-of-center, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the heavy black block of text in the upper-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text in the top-left, moves diagonally down to the subject's face, then follows the gaze toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space in the upper-left and lower-left, filled with textured grey-blue gradients.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with mid-range values; highlights are soft and diffused rather than bright.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and desaturated blues

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: R and A have very tight counters
Vertical strokes are significantly thicker than horizontal connectors due to compression
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage with vertical stacking for impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality.
Matches the ultra-narrow, heavy grotesque style of the 70s.
A modern alternative that can be vertically scaled to match.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus oil painting of a man with long dark hair, looking forward, against a textured grey-blue gradient background with a diagonal grain. Add a thick black border around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of ultra-compressed, bold black sans-serif text in the top-left corner, stacked vertically with tight leading.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-compressed and black?
Is the portrait texture soft and painterly?
Is there a black border framing the image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Original artist name or specific branding
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is not overlapping the subject's face.
Ensure the grain does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the black border is uniform on all four sides.
Confirm the typography is strictly uppercase and vertically stretched.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus painterly portrait + ultra-compressed bold sans-serif + diagonal grain texture + black frame border.
